The Smartwatch Apple Wishes They Built.

Solstyz™ captures infrasonic signals your Apple Watch can’t, detecting early issues in your heart, lungs, and arteries.

No wires. No wait times. Just real-time medical intelligence from your wrist.

The Problem

Most wearables track steps. They miss what matters. 85% of the world has no access to early cardiac, lung, or fetal screening.

Solstyz helps close that gap, before symptoms show.

The Breakthrough

We went lower. Much lower.

Solstyz taps into a hidden frequency range — 0.01 to 500 Hz. That’s deeper than any smartwatch, detecting health signals from your heart, lungs, arteries, and unborn child.

No patches. No probes. Just precision on your wrist.

What It Does

Solstyz delivers early health alerts, before symptoms appear:

  • 1. Detects gradual dysfunction in heart, lungs, and arteries
  • 2. Streams data securely to your phone or provider
  • 3. Uses unique infrasonic biomarkers
  • 4. Built for cardiac, respiratory, and remote health use
